drivingQuestion: Do blemishes spread over several places invalidate the etrog less or more than concentrated ones?
outcomeNote: Rava's objection stands; the next unit relocates Rav's statement to the seifa

segments.he: עָלְתָה חֲזָזִית. אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא: דָּבָר זֶה רַבֵּינוּ הַגָּדוֹל אֲמָרוֹ, הַמָּקוֹם יִהְיֶה בְּעֶזְרוֹ: לֹא שָׁנוּ אֶלָּא בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד, אֲבָל בִּשְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשָׁה מְקוֹמוֹת — כָּשֵׁר. אֲמַר לֵיהּ רָבָא: אַדְּרַבָּה, בִּשְׁנַיִם וּשְׁלֹשָׁה מְקוֹמוֹת הָוֵה לֵיהּ כִּמְנוּמָּר, וּפָסוּל.
segments.en: § The mishna continues: «If boil-like blemishes arose» on the majority of the etrog, it is unfit. «Rav Ḥisda said: This statement was stated by our great rabbi,» Rav, «and may the Omnipresent» come «to his assistance.» The Sages «taught» this halakha «only» in a case where the blemishes are concentrated «in one place; however,» if they are distributed «in two or three places» throughout the etrog, «it is fit.» Rava «said to» Rav Ḥisda: If the blemishes are distributed in «two or three places, it is as if» the etrog were «speckled» with different colors in different places; it lacks beauty «and is» certainly «unfit.»
